subject: 丁村民居丁坤大院院内厅堂与厢房片段
caption: 丁村民居 · 丁坤大院院内厅堂
清乾隆时期 · 庭院视角

sources.author: 青の日记，摄影者未单独署名

source_note: 照片图注明确为丁坤大院，采用院内朝向三间厅堂的视角，保留两侧厢房前段与两根明柱；主厅屋面两端在实拍中被厢房遮挡，因此图版也保留庭院遮挡，不臆画完整独立屋顶。清乾隆断代依据连达在《中华民居》的现场记录；不将整个丁村最早1593纪年套用此院。格心和雕刻只概括主要轮廓。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one refined heritage architecture illustration for the 访古 collection.
Image1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY: match the Longmen Buddha drawing's elegant delicate slightly organic thin contours and ample blank spaces. Image2 is the ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY: Ding Kun courtyard at Dingcun village, Xiangfen, Shanxi, a Qing Qianlong residential courtyard. Draw exactly this photographed inward-looking courtyard, NOT a temple.
Preserve the central three-bay timber hall with TWO freestanding front columns on its carved stone bases; the end posts are against side walls. Keep the wide central doorway with a small low door visible through it, original actual lattice-and-panel doors, carved broad lintel, plain tiled sloping roof and low straight ridge. Keep short visible portions of BOTH brick side wings in the photograph's gentle one-point perspective; their upper clerestory windows and lower doors surround the narrow courtyard. The main roof's ends disappear behind these wings as photographed; do not invent unobserved free-standing gable ends. Draw the courtyard as a bounded architectural fragment with naturally ending side-wing outlines, centered with white margins, not a filled rectangle. The complete visible roof section and central hall remain uncut. No invented upper floor on the central hall, no pagodas, no temple roof ornaments.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. All openings, windows and surfaces remain WHITE with fine outlines only. Draw sparse contours for key lattice patterns and carved lintel, omitting tiny repeated carving and nearly all roof-tile rows and brick courses. No gray shading, no black shadow masses, crosshatching, photographic grain, color, texture, gradients. Remove red lanterns, banners, writing, posters, modern pipes and fire extinguishers, foreground loose stone blocks and paving texture. Use only a few short courtyard ground and step lines. No text, watermark, frame, labels or border. Landscape 1536 x 1024, entire selected courtyard fragment within 82% width and 80% height, balanced generous white margin all around. Keep actual proportions and the photo's modest perspective without making up a complete bird's-eye courtyard plan.

historical_sources.title: 中华民居·画中民居：汾河岸边的丁村古民居
historical_sources.evidence: 丁村民俗博物馆所在老宅由丁坤、丁嘉伦、丁溪莲三代于清乾隆年间修建，历时50年；正房三开间。

historical_sources.title: 山陕古民居——丁村古建筑群申报世界文化遗产研究
historical_sources.publisher: 清华同衡乡土建筑研究所
historical_sources.evidence: 丁村保留明万历至民国40组院落，分北、中、南、西北四院区，1988年列全国重点文物保护单位；明确整体村落与单院年代差别。

site_recommendation.place: 山西襄汾 · 新城镇丁村
site_recommendation.lede: 汾河东岸的丁村把晋南家族的生活收进一座座四合院。丁坤大院的三间厅堂以木雕和石础见长，两侧厢房围出深而安静的院心。

facts.label: 明清宅院
facts.text: 丁村古建筑群现存院落跨明万历至民国，所绘丁坤大院属于清乾隆时期营建。

facts.label: 三代营建
facts.text: 连达的现场记录指出，此院由丁坤、丁嘉伦、丁溪莲祖孙三代相继修建。

facts.label: 院内视角
facts.text: 本图选三间厅堂和两侧厢房局部，保留木构廊柱与庭院关系，不代表完整村落总平面。
